description: Get Census ACS 2020–2024 5-year demographics for a specific census tract: total population, population 18+, veteran count, veteran percentage, poverty count + percentage, unemployment, median household income. Useful when you have a resource location or want to contextualize advice for a veteran ("Your area has X veterans + Y% poverty rate, here are resources tailored to that"). Accepts FIPS state/county/tract codes, OR a resource_id to look up the tract via the resource's location.

resource_id.description: Alternative — look up demographics for the tract a resource sits in

name: get_tract_demographics
title: Census tract demographics
